{{quotation|McLaren’s newest line of hybrid vehicles has its sights set on the Horizon Festival, and it’s ready to race. Putting together the loud and proud power of a twin-turbo V-6 and a silent but deadly electric power train, this car makes a combined bhp of 671 horsepower. Sitting in the highest level of performance, the Artura has a 0 – 100 kmh time of 2.6 seconds. To make the best use of the combined gas and electric systems, the new Artura was built using the brand-new Carbon Lightweight Architecture on its body as well as fitting air vents and the signature McLaren scissor doors. Experience the feeling of mad power that only a car maker with McLaren’s pedigree could imprint into a hybrid with the 2023 McLaren Artura.|Official description|<ref>{{ref|https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-Horizon-Race-Off|Forza Horizon 5 - Horizon Race-Off|forza.net|03-26-2024}}</ref>}}
The 2023 '''McLaren Artura''' - abbreviated as "McL. Artura '23" - is a rear-wheel drive hybrid supercar by [[McLaren]].

It appears in ''[[Forza Horizon 5]]'' as part of [[Forza Horizon 5/Series 32|Series 32]], [[Forza Motorsport (2023)|''Forza Motorsport'' (2023)]] as part of [[Forza Motorsport (2023)/Update 12.0|Update 12.0]] and ''[[Forza Horizon 6]]''.

==Trivia==
*In ''Forza Motorsport'' (2023), it was listed with a value of 1 CR prior to [[Forza Motorsport (2023)/Update 15|Update 15]].
*It was revealed for ''Forza Horizon 6'' on April 10, 2026.
